chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from al-ʿAbbās, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Abān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
“When you perform salat (prayer), then perform salat (prayer) in your sandals if they are tahir (ritually pure), for it is said that this is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition).”
Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, said: And one may perform salat (prayer) in the khuff and the jurmūq if it has a ساق.

key_terms.الْجُرْمُوقِ: an outer footwear worn over the khuff or foot
key_terms.طَاهِرَةً: ritually pure and free from najasah

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while wearing sandals or khuff in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing salat (prayer) in sandals is permissible when they are tahir (ritually pure), and it is regarded as being from the sunnah (prophetic tradition). The closing statement adds that prayer in khuff and jurmūq is also allowed under the stated condition.
